title: RL at the eval depth only: fine-tune and sample at 8 loops, never shallower
description: Pretraining unchanged (random 1-8 loops). In rl(), every loop count is the eval's 8: each round samples every target 12 times at 8 loops (the baseline: 8 times at each of 1, 2, 4, 8), and the 600-step fine-tune draws its per-batch loop count from FT_LOOPS = (8,) instead of TRAIN_LOOPS = 1..8 (a new model.train_loops attribute that rl() sets). RL_K is 12 rather than 32 because sampling at 8 loops costs about 2.5x per sample and fine-tuning at 8 loops about 1.6x per step, and five rounds must still fit in RL_SECS. Everything else in RL (replay, weighting, optimizer, schedule, round rule) is the incumbent's.
hypothesis: The incumbent's fine-tune draws a loop count from 1..8 per batch, so every RL proof must be learnable at 1 loop and the shared core converges to a depth-invariant fixed point: in run 500 per-sample accuracy on the RL targets was 0.763 at both 4 and 8 loops by round 5, after being 0.081 vs 0.088 before any fine-tuning, so RL erased what depth added. Fine-tuning and sampling only at 8 loops removes the shallow-depth constraint: nothing stops passes 5-8 from doing work that passes 1-4 cannot undo, so the 8-loop computation gets all of the fine-tune signal and the proofs it learns are the ones found at 8 loops. Specialization to a single depth also helped the spike: its fixed-2 model beat the 1-4 model at 2 loops (666 vs 644). The 2-loop diagnostic should fall well below the incumbent's 657, since 2 loops is no longer trained in RL; that gap is the trivial part of 'loops pay'. The real test is whether the metric at 8 loops rises above 675.
expected_delta: metric at 8 loops +10 to +25 over 675 (3-seed mean roughly 685-700) if depth was being suppressed; about -10 to -20 if the 4-loop plateau is a capacity ceiling and the lost attempts (12 per round at one depth instead of 32 across four) cost RL progress. metric_diag at 2 loops drops to roughly 550-630. RL targets solved after round 1 lower than 500's 287 (fewer attempts), cumulative RL solved near 1150-1200 if five rounds fit.

arch.type: looped gpt: 1 entry + 2 shared core x n + 1 exit Peri-LN blocks, LayerNorm(state)+entry re-injection per loop

optimizer.name: muon (polar express) on block matrices and head + adamw on the rest

config.init: orthogonal on block matrices, fork default elsewhere

rl.rounds: until another round would not fit in RL_SECS
rl.ft_optimizer: adamw, warmup 50 then cosine to lr/10
rl.loss: next-token CE on the last loop's output

rl.oracle: Lean AND nd_verify accepted samples of the model's own attempts

eval.metric: dev-transfer theorems solved at L_true >= 7 with KNOB at EVAL_LEVEL
